=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:957 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Git errors are suppressed during baseline capture, which can leave an empty baseline and make subsequent worktree comparisons misleading.
  WHY: An empty baseline causes `grep -vxFf` to treat current untracked bootstrap artifacts as Codex changes, producing false-positive delta detection; reviewers disagreed on whether this is merely diagnostic noise or a correctness issue, so severity uses the highest stated level.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1092 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The success-no-op regex may miss legitimate “already implemented” phrasings.
  WHY: Reviewers consistently noted missing variants such as `already done`, `already satisfied`, `already exists`, `already present`, `no changes required`, and `nothing to do`, which can cause unnecessary re-issues when the task is actually complete.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1092 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The success-no-op regex can over-match failure explanations that merely contain success-like phrases.
  WHY: A failure message containing phrases like `no file changes were made` could be misclassified as a success-no-op, though reviewers noted this is mitigated when `codex_delta` is non-empty.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:957 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Git errors are suppressed, creating an empty baseline on baseline-capture failure.
  WHY: Empty baseline makes `grep -vxFf` pass all lines, so bootstrap artifacts can be treated as Codex changes and diagnostics become misleading.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1092 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Regex may still miss some legitimate success phrasings.
  WHY: Phrases like `already done`, `already fixed`, `no modifications needed`, `task complete`, or `successfully completed` would not trigger the no-op short-circuit, causing unnecessary re-issues.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1092 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Regex can over-match failure explanations containing the same phrases.
  WHY: A message like `no file changes were made due to permission issues` could be mistaken for a success-no-op, though this is partly mitigated by the delta check.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
(No findings reported.)

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:957 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Baseline capture suppresses git errors and can produce an empty baseline.
  WHY: A broken git environment can make `grep -vxFf` report bootstrap artifacts as changes, creating misleading file-change signals.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1092 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Success-no-op regex may miss common variations.
  WHY: Valid outputs like `already satisfied`, `already exists`, `already present`, `no changes required`, or `nothing to do` would not be recognized and would trigger unnecessary re-issues.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1092 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Success-no-op regex may over-match.
  WHY: Failure explanations containing the matched phrases could be misclassified as a success-no-op, though the `codex_delta` check reduces this risk.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1094, 10 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Flag file creation has an edge case if `RUNTIME_DIR` is unexpectedly empty or unusable.
  WHY: Guard 0 skips when `RUNTIME_DIR` is empty, but permission problems or malformed paths could still cause the no-op flag write to fail and fall through to re-issue safely.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:957 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The baseline capture command lacks error handling and can create an empty or partially written baseline when `git status` fails.
  WHY: An empty baseline makes `grep -vxFf` classify current worktree paths as new Codex changes, which can cause false-positive file-change detection and suppress the intended retry-nudge behavior.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1092 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The success-no-op regex is broad enough to match failure explanations that include success-like phrases.
  WHY: A failure message that happens to contain one of the matched substrings could be misclassified as a legitimate success-no-op, causing the issue to be closed incorrectly with `ai:closed`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

(No findings reported.)
